status: Research-verified 2026-11-02. Categories A-D integrated as adapters (offline-tested); live bulk downloads still require a declared collection envelope. Category E excluded for discovery (see reason).
notes: All sources feed the one canonical Gabriel pipeline. Parcel existence never establishes vacancy or market availability; commercial-use classification from appraisal land-use codes is a claim requiring the shared verification policy, not a verified fact.

sources.update_frequency: Current appraisal-year file; replaced as DCAD publishes updates

sources.status: integrated via dcad_bulk exchange (same adapter as parcel geometry)

sources.exclusion_reason: Property appraisal and parcel records for Dallas County are administered by DCAD and are already integrated above. The County itself publishes per-record web portals (tax/clerk) with no verified free bulk download or API endpoint, and some records are fee-based (paid access needs separate owner approval). Revisit only if the County publishes a bulk/API endpoint.
